subject: Bank-link upload race condition causing duplicate vendor accounts — urgent manual onboarding
messages:
From: Marie Langston <marie@wildwoodcrafts.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@wildwoodcrafts.com
Date: Sun, 30 Jun 2029 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor invite — bank link step keeps looping

Hi Vanessa,

We tried to finish the onboarding link this morning and are stuck on the bank-link step. When I upload our W-9 the page accepts the file but immediately refreshes and sends me back to the ‘Enter bank details’ screen. After I submit the bank info it shows an error: ‘An account already exists for this email’ and then redirects me to the login page. Trying to sign in just pulls me back into the same invite link, so it’s a loop.

I attached the screenshot of the error and a copy of the W-9. We need to get this vendor setup so the PO can be paid next week — is there a way you can complete this from your side?

Thanks,
Marie Langston
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Wildwood Crafts
Attachments: screenshot-banklink-loop.png (image/png), wildwood-w9.pdf (application/pdf)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Marie Langston <marie@wildwoodcrafts.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 Jun 2029 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor invite — bank link step keeps looping

Hi Marie — thanks for the details and the attachments, that helps. Sorry you’re blocked. We’ve seen a rare race condition where multiple invite attempts cause the onboarding service to create two profiles almost simultaneously; the frontend then trips over the duplicate and sends users back to the invite link instead of completing the bank link.

Immediate plan:
- I’m escalating to Ops/Infra (cc’d). Ben, can you check for duplicate vendor records for wildwoodcrafts.com and suspend the extra account if present?
- Karthik, can the team look at callback logs for the invite token Marie pasted? I’ll send you the raw headers/trace in the Jira ticket.
- For now Marie, I can create the vendor record manually and issue a temporary PO so payments aren’t blocked. If you’re OK with that I’ll attach the PO and next steps to this thread.

Quick workarounds you can try while we fix the underlying issue:
- Try the invite link in a private/incognito browser (this forces a fresh session).
- If your organization has an alternate contact email (no forwarding rules), try using that email to accept the invite; plus-addressing has caused problems for a few vendors.

I’ll update within the hour once I have an Ops confirmation.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0147

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 Jun 2029 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor invite — bank link step keeps looping (internal)

Internal notes: I pulled the invite trace for Marie’s email and we have two vendor records created within a 12-second window: vendor_id 98742 (active) and vendor_id 98743 (orphaned). The orphaned record has the completed W-9 attachment but the webhook callback from the bank-link provider failed with a 409 duplicate key when it tried to merge the credentials. Frontend then returned the invite-token to the user, creating the loop.

Action taken:
- Placed vendor_id 98743 into quarantine (won’t be visible in the UI).
- Normalized vendor_id 98742 so it includes the uploaded W-9.
- Opened INF-5821 and attached the header traces and the bank provider callback payload for Karthik’s team.

Temporary support: I created a one-off vendor profile and generated PO #3471 to clear the upcoming payment. I attached the temp PO to this message for Vanessa to send to the vendor. This bypasses the bank-link step for the immediate invoice; after payment we’ll have the engineering fix rolled out and ask the vendor to reconnect their bank link so ACH can be set up properly.

Ben Carter
Platform Ops
Redwood Inference
Attachments: temp_po_3471.pdf
Related: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5821

Marie — we’ve created the vendor record on your behalf and issued a temporary PO so your payment won’t be delayed. PO number: 3471 (attached). You should receive a separate receipt when the invoice clears.

Next steps for Wildwood Crafts:
- We’ll follow up once the engineering patch is deployed (INF-5821) and ask you to re-link your bank account.
- If you’d like to complete verification sooner, you can also provide a voided check by replying to this thread and we’ll manually attach it to the vendor record.

Apologies for the friction; we’ll keep you posted and notify you when the invite flow is fixed.

Best,
